pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
